Shift.Name: Shift
Shift.Description: Toggle the Shift state of the calculator. Press Shift then the target button to use the function specified by the yellow text.

Alpha.Name: Alpha
Alpha.Description: Toggle the Alpha state of the calculator. Press Alpha then the target button to use the function specified by the red text.

Mode.Name: Mode
Mode.Description: Open the Mode menu to switch to other modes.
Mode.Warning: Only the Compute mode is currently implemented.

Shift-Mode.Name: Setup
Shift-Mode.Description: Open the Setup menu to change calculator settings. Contains angle mode and output mode settings.

Abs.Name: Abs
Abs.Description: Calculate the absolute value of an expression.

Cube.Name: $x^3$
Cube.Description: Calculate the third power of an expression.

Alpha-Cube.Name: : (Colon)
Alpha-Cube.Description: Input multiple expressions and calculate them in order.

Invert.Name: $x^{-1}$
Invert.Description: Calculate the inverse of an expression.

Factorial.Name: $x!$
Factorial.Description: Calculate the factorial of an integer.
Factorial.Warning: Only positive integer factorials are supported.

Fraction.Name: $\frac{\blacksquare}{\square}$
Fraction.Description: Create a fraction with a numerator and denominator. Consumes existing tokens to the left and right.

Shift-Fraction.Name: $\blacksquare\frac{\square}{\square}$
Shift-Fraction.Description: Create a mixed fraction with a whole, numerator, and denominator. Consumes existing tokens to the left and right.

Sqrt.Name: $\sqrt{\blacksquare}$
Sqrt.Description: Calculate the square root of an expression.

Shift-Sqrt.Name: $\sqrt[3]{\blacksquare}$
Shift-Sqrt.Description: Calculate the cube root of an expression.

Square.Name: $x^2$
Square.Description: Calculate the second power of an expression.

Power.Name: $x^\blacksquare$
Power.Description: Calculate the result of an expression raised to another expression.

Shift-Power.Name: $\sqrt[\blacksquare]{\square}$
Shift-Power.Description: Calculate an arbitrary root of an expression.
Shift-Power.Warning: Note that even roots of a negative number are undefined.

Log.Name: log
Log.Description: Calculate the base-10 logarithm of an expression.

Shift-Log.Name: $10^\blacksquare$
Shift-Log.Description: Calculate the result of 10 raised to an expression.

Ln.Name: ln
Ln.Description: Calculate the natural (base-e) logarithm of an expression.

Shift-Ln.Name: $e^\blacksquare$
Shift-Ln.Description: Calculate the result of Euler's number raised to an expression.

UnaryMinus.Description: Unary minus. Change the sign of an expression result.

Alpha-UnaryMinus.Name: A
Alpha-UnaryMinus.Description: Recall the value stored in variable A.

Degree.Name: $\degree ' "$
Degree.Description: If an output is present, express it in degree-minute-second form. Depends on angle mode.

Shift-Degree.Name: FACT
Shift-Degree.Description: If an output is present, perform prime factorisation on it. If factors are found, display them.

Alpha-Degree.Name: B
Alpha-Degree.Description: Recall the value stored in variable B.

Alpha-Hyp.Name: C
Alpha-Hyp.Description: Recall the value stored in variable C.

Sin.Name: sin
Sin.Description: Calculate the sine of an expression. Depends on angle mode.

Shift-Sin.Name: $\textsf{sin}^{-1}$
Shift-Sin.Description: Calculate the inverse sine of an expression. Finds a result between -π and π (-90° and 90°). Depends on angle mode.
Shift-Sin.Warning: The inverse sine function is defined over the domain [-1,1].

Alpha-Sin.Name: D
Alpha-Sin.Description: Recall the value stored in variable D.

Cos.Name: cos
Cos.Description: Calculate the cosine of an expression. Depends on angle mode.

Shift-Cos.Name: $\textsf{cos}^{-1}$
Shift-Cos.Description: Calculate the inverse cosine of an expression. Finds a result between 0 and 2π (0° and 180°). Depends on angle mode.
Shift-Cos.Warning: The inverse cosine function is defined over the domain [-1,1].

Alpha-Cos.Name: E
Alpha-Cos.Description: Recall the value stored in variable E.

Tan.Name: tan
Tan.Description: Calculate the tangent of an expression. Depends on angle mode.
Tan.Warning: The tangent function is not defined at its poles.

Shift-Tan.Name: $\textsf{tan}^{-1}$
Shift-Tan.Description: Calculate the inverse tangent of an expression. Finds a result between π and π (0° and 180°). Depends on angle mode.

Alpha-Tan.Name: F
Alpha-Tan.Description: Recall the value stored in variable F.

Recall.Name: RCL (Recall)
Recall.Description: Toggle the Recall state of the calculator. Press RCL then the target variable to recall it.

Shift-Recall.Name: STO (Store)
Shift-Recall.Description: Toggle the STO state of the calculator. When a valid expression is entered, press STO then the target variable.

Engineering.Name: ENG (Engineering)
Engineering.Description: If an output is present, express it in engineering notation. If the output is already in engineering notation, shift the decimal place left by 3.

Shift-Engineering.Name: ← (Engineering)
Shift-Engineering.Description: If an output is present, express it in engineering notation and shift the decimal place by 3. If the output is already in engineering notation, shift the decimal place right by a further 3.

LParen.Description: Expressions inside parentheses are evaluated first.

Shift-LParen.Description: Convert a percentage expression into a decimal (that is, multiply it by 100).

RParen.Description: Expressions inside parentheses are evaluated first.

Shift-RParen.Name: , (Comma)
Shift-RParen.Description: Delimiter for separating variables in multivariable functions.

Alpha-RParen.Name: X
Alpha-RParen.Description: Recall the value stored in variable X.

StandardToDecimal.Name: $\mathsf{\small{S}{\Leftrightarrow}{D}}$
StandardToDecimal.Description: If an output is present, try to express it as a fraction. If it is already a fraction, express it as a decimal.

Shift-StandardToDecimal.Name: $\mathsf{\small{{\scriptstyle a}\frac{b}{c}}{\Leftrightarrow}{\frac{d}{c}}}$
Shift-StandardToDecimal.Description: If an output is present, try to express it as a mixed fraction. If it is already a mixed fraction, express it as a fraction.

Alpha-StandardToDecimal.Name: Y
Alpha-StandardToDecimal.Description: Recall the value stored in variable Y.

MemoryPlus.Name: M+
MemoryPlus.Description: Evaluate the current expression. If successfull, add the result to the variable M.

Shift-MemoryPlus.Name: M-
Shift-MemoryPlus.Description: Evaluate the current expression. If successfull, subtract the result from the variable M.

Alpha-MemoryPlus.Name: M+
Alpha-MemoryPlus.Description: Recall the value stored in variable M.

Shift-9.Name: CLR (Clear)
Shift-9.Description: Open the Clear menu, where setup and memory can be cleared.

Del.Name: DEL (Delete)
Del.Description: Delete the symbol to the left of the cursor. If there is no symbol to the left, delete a symbol to the right.

Shift-Del.Name: INS
Shift-Del.Description: This function does nothing in MathIO mode.
Shift-Del.Warning: LineIO mode is not implemented yet.

AllClear.Name: AC (All Clear)
AllClear.Description: Delete all input and exit any menu.

Shift-6.Name: VERIFY
Shift-6.Warning: VERIFY mode is not implemented yet.

Shift-Multiply.Name: nPr (Permutation)
Shift-Multiply.Description: Calculate the number of permutations to arrange r items from a set of n items.

Alpha-Multiply.Name: GCD
Alpha-Multiply.Description: Find the greatest common denominator of two integers.

Shift-Divide.Name: nCr (Choose)
Shift-Divide.Description: Calculate the number of ways to choose r items from a set of n items.

Alpha-Divide.Name: LCM
Alpha-Divide.Description: Find the lowest common multiple of two integers.

Shift-Plus.Name: Pol (Polar)
Shift-Plus.Description: Convert rectangular coordinates (X,Y) to polar coordinates. If the result is used as part of another expression, only the modulus is preserved. Depends on angle mode.

Shift-Minus.Name: Pol (Polar)
Shift-Minus.Description: Convert polar coordinates (r,θ) to rectangular coordinates. If the result is used as part of another expression, only the X component is preserved. Depends on angle mode.

Shift-0.Name: Rnd (Round)
Shift-0.Description: Round the expression to the nearest integer. In the case of equal distance, round up.

Shift-Decimal.Name: Ran# (Random)
Shift-Decimal.Description: Returns a random number between 0 and 1. Not a function (no parentheses are expected).

Alpha-Decimal.Name: RanInt (Random Int)
Alpha-Decimal.Description: Returns a random integer between the specified bounds (inclusive).

ExponentialDigit.Name: $\small{\times}10^x$
ExponentialDigit.Description: A symbol used to create scientific notation from a number and integer. The number to the left will be multiplied by 10 to the power of the integer on the right. Note that no power symbol is expected.

Ans.Name: Abs
Ans.Description: Recall the result of the last calculation.

Shift-Ans.Name: DRG▶
Shift-Ans.Description: Open the menu of inline angle type conversions.

Calculate.Name: = (Calculate)
Calculate.Description: Evaluate the current input and display it.
